interpretation: Native checking is below1percent of the GKR numerical stage; keep mandatory artifact/transcript reconstruction.
Raw coefficient ingress is the largest measured GKR cost; device MAIN reuse and bounded pinned staging address it.
Sum/reduce+fold account for13,778 of15,795 traversal launches; batched shared-transcript kernels and graph replay target that overhead.
No additional synchronization was introduced for timing; event results are queried after existing joins.
CUDA event spans include host enqueue gaps inside each marked stream interval; they are not pure kernel-active Nsight time.
Ingress includes pageable H2D coefficient copies, twiddles and one device-to-device source clone; its effective rate is not a raw PCIe bandwidth measurement.
An earlier diagnostic run was rejected by native constraints after a composition geometry-cache destination bug; the corrected run here restored exact native proof bytes.
Binding remains CPU; this run does not establish a fully resident prover or whole-block GPU throughput.
